title: regenerate-build-images-and-update-dependency-lockfiles
author: Ava Patel
release_notes: Regenerated base build container images to pick up OS security patches and refreshed package lockfiles for several build-time toolchains. No runtime behavior changes expected.
description:
Context and motivation: Periodic maintenance to regenerate base build images and refresh dependency lockfiles after upstream package updates and a recently patched container base image. This reduces CI flakiness observed in ephemeral build containers and patches several low-severity CVEs flagged by the infra team. This PR is scoped to build tooling and repo hygiene only; no runtime or public API changes.

What this PR does (single continuous description): Updated Dockerfiles used for CI builder images to reference the patched base image digest and bumped some build-tool apt packages. Re-ran lockfile regeneration for the monorepo's Node and Python toolchains: updated package-lock.json in tools/ci/npm, yarn lock snapshots in examples, and pip-compile outputs for the internal build helper. Also added a small script (scripts/ci/verify-img.sh) to make the next regen easier and to assert that build images include required system libs.

Checklist and action items carried out: - Regenerated and committed build image manifests and one-off Dockerfile tweaks (tools/ci/Dockerfile.builder). - Upgraded pinned versions for eslint, typescript, and the TypeScript ESLint parser in redwood-sdk-typescript devDeps to address a linting false-positive observed in CI. - Recompiled pip-compile requirements for build utilities and checked in requirements-build.txt. - Added CI smoke to the nightly workflow to verify builder images by running a minimal container run that asserts presence of git, python3, node. - Ran the repo-wide lint/test matrix locally and fixed two minor lint failures caused by stricter rule enforcement in the new eslint release.

Commits (summary): - a1f3d1f: ci: bump base builder image digest and regenerate manifests - 9c4b2e0: tools: add scripts/ci/verify-img.sh and makefile target - d7c45b2: deps: refresh npm/yarn lockfiles and bump eslint/typescript devDeps - b3e8a9a: py: pip-compile updated requirements-build.txt - f20c138: fix: lint rule adjustments after eslint upgrade

High-level files changed (illustrative list): - tools/ci/Dockerfile.builder (base image digest updated) - tools/ci/manifest-2025-11.yml (regen manifest) - tools/ci/verify-img.sh (new) - redwood-sdk-typescript/package.json (devDeps bumped) - redwood-sdk-typescript/package-lock.json (lockfile) - examples/webapp/yarn.lock (refreshed) - infra/requirements-build.txt (pip-compile output) - .github/workflows/nightly-builder-check.yml (added image smoke) - .github/workflows/lint.yml (minor rule toleration fix)

CI summary: The branch ran through our standard checks: unit, lint, integration (sliced by runtime), and the new nightly-builder-check workflow. The initial runs failed lint in two modules (caused by updated eslint defaults). After addressing the two lint errors, CI passed all checks. The nightly-builder-check job verifies that the builder image contains git, python3, node, and that the container exits with 0 for the verification script. Flaky test mitigation: added a short retry wrapper for a single flaky integration test that occasionally times out under the updated builder VM image.

Review conversation (condensed): - Diego Marquez: "Can you add a one-line note in the release notes explaining this is build-image maintenance only and not user-facing? Also confirm whether the base image digest is pinned to a digest or tag." -- Ava: "Added release_notes and switched Dockerfile to pin the digest; included the digest in the Dockerfile.builder comment." - Lena Fischer: "Two small nits on scripts/ci/verify-img.sh (shebang + chmod 755). Also, please run the pip-compile output through black formatting check." -- Ava: "Addressed both nits and ran black; updated commit d7c45b2." - Omar Khan: "CI looks green; can we gate the nightly-builder-check to run only on main and release branches to avoid noise from forks?" -- Ava: "Updated the workflow trigger accordingly (only main and release/*)."

Risk assessment and rollout: Low risk. Changes are limited to build-time images and dev dependency lockfiles. We validated that downstream CI jobs pass with the regenerated images. No migration steps required for customers. Rolling/merge notes: squash-merge to keep history compact; commit message includes a short changelog and pointer to ENG-4219.

Merge outcome: Approved by all reviewers on 2025-11-05; CI passed after fixes; PR merged via squash. Post-merge actions: - Infra will schedule a separate infra-run to rebuild cached builder images in our shared registry (ticket created: ENG-4221). - A follow-up will monitor nightly builder-check for two weekdays to catch any hidden regressions.

Related work and references: ENG-4219 (lockfile hygiene), SUP-879 (infra CVE report), internal doc: docs/ops/ci-image-rotation.md for the regeneration process.
